facts.existing_value: A null WObj is a no-op. If relative-position flag bit 0 is clear, the function directly replaces pos.x and sets flag bit 1. If bit 0 is set, it first transforms the stored position when both the AObj and its attached JObj are available; regardless of whether that attachment exists, it then clears bit 0, replaces pos.x, and sets bit 1.
